dedupe_keys.name: acess ecuador open data health establishment licensing and operating permits

description: ACESS, Ecuador's agency for the quality of health services and prepaid medicine, licenses public and private health establishments and issues their operating permits. Its open data page read on 2026-09-29 says the agency has published three datasets on the national open data portal datosabiertos.gob.ec: licensing of health establishments, operating permits, and registration of health professionals' degrees. The agency site also links a statistics dashboard on operating permits (a Grafana board on servicios.acess.gob.ec), reports on compliance and service portfolios. Coverage: national, Ecuador, public and private health establishments. Format and access: free open data downloads on datosabiertos.gob.ec and a web dashboard. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the dataset pages on datosabiertos.gob.ec returned HTTP 403 to the cloud on 2026-09-29, so formats, dates and fields were not read; the establishment lists are regulatory records, not a geocoded facility inventory; the old address calidadsalud.gob.ec no longer answers. Simulation uses: inventory of licensed health facilities for health service accessibility and emergency response studies. Related records: compare with Brazil's CNES health establishments (data-cnes-brazil-health-establishments-api) and Chad's health facility list (data-chad-health-facilities-moh).
